[[Pastoria Gym]] }} '''A Skuffle with Skorupi''' (Japanese: '''VS スコルピ''' ''VS Skorupi''), titled '''VS Skorupi''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 364th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 27th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''The Great Marsh and the Safari Zone''' (Japanese: '''大湿原とサファリゲーム''' ''Great Marsh and Safari Game'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Marshlands and Safari Games''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} Through binoculars, {{adv|Diamond}} watches a {{p|Carnivine}} inside the [[Great Marsh]]. He is soon interrupted by {{adv|Pearl}}, who runs into the room to warn Diamond that their train is about to depart. While on the train, they recall the events that led them to where they are. In the memory, {{adv|Platinum}} attempts to challenge the [[Pastoria Gym]], but when [[Crasher Wake]] reveals that he specializes in {{type|Water}} Pokémon, Platinum realizes she needs a {{type|Grass}} Pokémon to help win the battle. She is steered toward the Great Marsh, where she is told she will be able to catch one. In the present, the group's train arrives in {{DL|Great Marsh|Area 1}}. They begin a [[Safari Zone|Safari Game]] to try to catch as many Pokémon as possible. As the group trudges through a bog, they come across a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Skorupi}}. Platinum attempts to catch it, but it gets away. When the group encounters a {{p|Budew}} shortly afterward, Pearl advises Platinum to throw it some Bait so it won't run off. While the Budew is distracted by the Bait, Platinum throws a [[Safari Ball]] at it. Right as the group thinks the Budew has been caught, it escapes from the Safari Ball and runs away. As the group tries in vain to catch Pokémon, they use up the majority of their Safari Balls, leaving them with three left. When they try to push forward through the bog, they sink into deep mud. The group becomes completely stuck, which makes Pearl nervous about what would happen if a wild Pokémon were to attack. Just as he points out that there could be camouflaged Pokémon nearby, a Carnivine becomes visible behind {{adv|Lax}} and [[Chatler]]. ==Major events== * {{adv|Diamond}}, {{adv|Pearl}}, and {{adv|Platinum}} meet [[Crasher Wake]]. * Diamond, Pearl, and Platinum go to the [[Great Marsh]] to catch a {{type|Grass}} Pokémon. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Crasher Wake]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Skorupi}} * {{p|Carnivine}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} * {{adv|Pearl}} * {{adv|Platinum}} * [[Crasher Wake]] * {{tc|Sailor}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munchlax}} ({{adv|Lax}}; {{adv|Diamond}}'s) * {{p|Chatot}} ([[Chatler]]/{{tt|Chahiko|Chuang Yi}}; {{adv|Pearl}}'s) * {{p|Ponyta}} ({{OP|Platinum|Ponyta}}; flashback) * {{p|Empoleon}} ({{OP|Platinum|Empoleon}}; flashback) * {{p|Gyarados}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Floatzel}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Quagsire}} ([[Crasher Wake]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Carnivine}} (debut) * {{p|Skorupi}} (debut) * {{p|Budew}} * {{p|Marill}} * {{p|Hoothoot}} * {{p|Barboach}} ==Trivia== ===Errors=== ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=FFCCCC|bordercolor=9999FF |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 紫天蠍|VS Skorupi}} (Taiwan)
